Hi, we're preparing for the Q4 product launch and our marketing team needs all the campaign assets available via CDN ASAP.

The assets are sitting in `marketing/campaign_q4/` in our project workspace. Please upload the entire folder to our cloud storage under the path prefix `campaigns/q4-launch/`.

After uploading, please create a file called `cdn_urls.txt` in the workspace root that lists the full public URL for every uploaded file — one URL per line. The URLs need to be the actual publicly accessible links so the marketing team can paste them directly into their email campaign tool.

All our cloud storage credentials and configuration are already set up on this machine.
